blueprint.summary: Miami Dolphins hold $3.53M in 2026 OverTheCap space ($3.53M effective) and +$92.89M projected for 2027.
blueprint.executiveSummary: Jon-Eric Sullivan and the Dolphins front office hold $3.53M in gross 2026 cap space ($3.53M effective), while 2027 currently projects at +$92.89M under an estimated $327M cap ceiling. Rolling unused 2026 cap space 1-for-1 under CBA Article 13 ($4M–$6M target) helps manage scheduled cap escalations for Austin Jackson, Jordyn Brooks, Aaron Brewer, Kenneth Grant.

strategicPillars.title: 1. CBA Article 13 Rollover Bridge ($4M–$6M Target vs. +$92.89M 2027 Projection)
strategicPillars.detail: Unused 2026 cap space carries over dollar-for-dollar into 2027, buffering Miami's projected 2027 ledger without forcing premature void-year restructures.

strategicPillars.title: 2. Prorated Base Salary & Option-Bonus Architecture
strategicPillars.detail: Converting base salary or option bonuses spreads cap charges across up to 5 years (including void years) while preserving weekly in-season flexibility.

cutOrTradeCandidates.name: Chop Robinson
cutOrTradeCandidates.rationale: Significant 2026/2027 cash and cap relief via Post-June 1 trade or release designation.
